trust_decision.summary: Whether an injected file path may resolve outside the mounted guest filesystem is decided at the write sink in nova/virt/disk/api.py: every path is joined onto the mount root, then written as root with 'tee'/'cp' without any containment check, so path identity (including symlinks planted in the image) is never validated.

landing_point.why: It is the only function that takes a request-supplied path, strips the leading '/', joins it onto the mounted image root and writes it as root with utils.execute('tee', ...), and it is the first place an engineer who read 'arbitrary file overwrite in file injection' would look.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only the personality path in inject_files is request-supplied; the key/net/metadata/passwd writers use literal file names and the XenAPI caller mounts the image itself, so hardening those four injectors looks like unnecessary defence-in-depth and the personality path alone looks like the whole bug.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: SSH key injection must append to an existing authorized_keys (tee -a) so keys already baked into the image survive; routing key injection through a check helper that only overwrites truncates them.

O6_input_shapes: absolute path with leading '/' (stripped with lstrip before joining) - nova/virt/disk/api.py:315, fix.diff:67
relative path joined onto the mount root
path with '..' components escaping the mount root (rejected after realpath/readlink)
path with '..' that normalises back inside the mount root (must stay allowed, fix.diff:60-63)
symlinks inside the mounted image resolving outside it (resolved by 'readlink -nm' as root, fix.diff:420-425)
literal file names injected by the key/net/metadata/passwd helpers
append vs overwrite mode (new append flag, fix.diff:66-81)
multiple (path, contents) pairs in one inject_files list (nova/virt/disk/api.py:258-259)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A XenAPI-specific mount-then-inject wrapper calling disk.inject_data_into_fs on its own tmpdir.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Nova already carries one mount/inject/umount wrapper per virt backend, so a maintainer adding image injection for XenAPI would naturally write it here instead of reusing the libvirt path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A driver-local file-injection wrapper that joins or filters paths before delegating to disk.inject_files.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Each virt driver already owns its image and mount plumbing, so a per-driver fix is a natural place for a maintainer to put a path check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: bind() writes a root-owned file whose path is built from the caller-supplied instance name with the same tee-as-root idiom and no containment check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same idiom in the same module, so hardening root file writes would plausibly be extended to it.
